We are FitnessLivee Training Academy, Mumbai — a leading spa & massage training institute with 10+ years of experience and 5000+ successful students.

On this channel, you will learn:
✔ Professional massage techniques
✔ Spa therapy training (practical + theory)
✔ Client handling & service improvement tips
✔ Career guidance in spa & wellness industry

We help you build a high-income skill and start your career in massage therapy.

🎓 Online & Offline Certification Courses Available
📍 Based in Mumbai | Serving all over India

📞 Contact us for training & certification
